mechanism: Selegiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate monoaminergic effects, and ginseng may have sympathomimetic and serotonergic properties, increasing risk of hypertension and serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor blood pressure and CNS symptoms closely; consider alternative herbal supplement or reduce selegiline dose if used together; counsel patient on avoiding high-dose ginseng.
